subject: Post-call: Model fit recommendations + RAG tuning proposal for Veridian Health
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: Model fit recommendations + RAG tuning proposal for Veridian Health

Hi Alice / Mark —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed next step plan so we keep momentum:

Summary of needs we heard
- Knowledge domain: internal policies, clinical guidelines, and payer-contract FAQs (~120k docs, many short policies).
- Key risks: hallucination on policy language, requirement to reference source docs in responses, SLA: P95 latency <= 600ms for chat flow, throughput ~50 concurrent users.
- Compliance: data residency in US, strict audit logs, and redaction of PHI.

Recommended quick model-fit matrix (initial pilot):
- High-quality (best grounding): RWX-50B-fp16 (higher token-cost, lower hallucination)
- Balanced (good latency / cost): RWX-13B-quant (4-bit) — target for most pilot queries
- Cost-efficient (batching/auto-scaling for background tasks): RWX-7B-4bit

RAG architecture suggestions
- Retriever: dense embeddings index (512-768d) persisted in FAISS with document chunking at ~300 tokens; expiration window 30 days for caches.
- Reranker: bi-encoder to shortlist + lightweight cross-encoder reranker (RWX-cross-1) for top-10 re-ranking when precision is required for policy citations.
- Grounding mode: include top-3 source excerpts inline and a confidence score; expose source-ids in API for auditability.

Metrics we recommend tracking during pilot
- Grounding Coverage: percent of answers with at least one source overlap (target > 95%)
- Hallucination Rate: percent of answers flagged by manual eval as unsupported (target < 5%)
- Precision@1 / MRR@5 for retrieval+rerank (baseline expectations in linked benchmark)
- P95 latency for generation + rerank (target <= 600ms)

Attachments I shared for the pilot:
- veridian_prompt_set_v1.csv (sample prompts / expected answers matrix)
- rwx_benchmark_summary_veridian.pdf (quick modeled estimates using similar healthcare workloads)
- proposed-eval-plan.docx (timeline + gating criteria)

Proposed immediate next steps
1) You: confirm the most critical workflows (policy lookup, contract Q&A, compliance checks) — can you mark top 2? (answer by Tue EOD)
2) Us: run a 3-day smoke benchmark using your sample prompts and our balanced model (RWX-13B-quant) — we’ll deliver initial grounding metrics and latency numbers.
3) Joint: schedule 45-min technical tuning session with your infra (we can do next Wed 10–11am PT).

If that all looks OK I’ll kick off the smoke run and share a short eval dashboard.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Reranker cost: rough estimate for cross-encoder rerank top-10 is ~1.8x token-cost vs generator-only on our pricing model for interactive queries (depends on sequence length). For the smoke run we’ll gate rerank sampling to 25% of queries so you can see quality delta without full spend.
- Smoke run plan: start Thu (11/22) morning PT, 72-hour run, sample set = your 30k export + our prompt set. We’ll return an initial dashboard by Monday with grounding coverage, hallucination rate, latency P50/P95, and Precision@1/MRR@5.
- Meeting invite: sent for Wed 11/24 10:00–10:45 PT (includes infra lead).

- Monica: run a parallel test with retrieval + rerank (top-10 with RWX-cross-1) for the 25% sample. Please use the prompt set attached to the thread and add any extra eval prompts you think are needed for policy language edge-cases.

Thanks all,
Rachel

Adding my tuning notes for the smoke run (internal):

Retrieval settings (recommended initial values)
- Chunk size: 280–320 tokens (helps keep context windows manageable; keeps citations concise).
- Overlap: 40 tokens (captures boundary context for policy language).
- Embedding model: RWX-embed-768 (dense, semantic).
- Index refresh: batch-upsert during smoke run cadence (no incremental online updates).

Reranker strategy
- Two-phase: bi-encoder shortlist top-50 (cosine) -> cross-encoder rerank top-10.
- Cross-encoder config: sequence truncation at 512 tokens, run with temperature=0 for deterministic ranking.
- Cost control: sample 25% of queries for full rerank during smoke; if uplift in Precision@1 > 6% we recommend moving to 50% for Phase 2.

Grounding / evaluation signals to instrument in the dashboard
- Source Attribution Accuracy (manual label sample) — capture whether the top cited source actually contains the asserted fact.
- Citation Density: avg number of source excerpts per answer (target 1–3).
- User-facing fallback rate: percent of queries where model returns "I don't know" or suggests human escalation (we want <8% for pilot).

Quick checklist for the run
- Use veridian_prompt_set_v1.csv as canonical prompts; add 30 edge-case prompts for ambiguous language (I'll attach shortly).
- Ensure audit logs include source doc ids + retrieval scores.
- Confirm embeddings pipeline uses 512-d fallback if RWX-embed-768 is unavailable.

I’ll attach the edge-case prompts and a short script for sampling for rerank. Marissa — when you have the baseline metrics, please push them to the Drive folder in the related_links and flag any surprises.

—Monica
